title: Wind Chimes in the Void
description: Two clusters of metallic wind chimes with cylindrical tubes and circular medallions hang against a dark, swirling background. Ethereal faces, a bull-like creature, and flowing smoke-like ribbons in purple, brown, and white emerge from the darkness around the chimes.
prompt: Surreal dark fantasy painting featuring multiple hanging wind chimes with long metal tubes and engraved circular medallions, surrounded by swirling purple and brown smoke that forms ghostly human faces and a black bull-like creature, floating in a deep black void with dramatic lighting and mysterious atmosphere.
